cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Sit with me for the allotment shed vote. It shouldn't look like just my project.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only support it if everyone gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Shared keys. Agreed. Will you join me now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring them over. We can present it together as the shared-access proposal.

mechanism: A uses professional proposal wording and meeting organisation to turn conditional shed support into a broader credible coalition.
confusable: D52 secures visible endorsement of a decision; D55 recruits people to A side so it appears broader, allowing terms to expand membership.
comparison: Pottery alternative recruits another class through extra access terms; shed alternative brings new plot holders into a shared-key proposal.
seedUse: Allotment shed, shared keys and new plot holders derive from D55-a; S03 adds precise access wording and presentation correction.
